about_the_game:
One -- or two -- players control New York City's mayoral candidate, Zohran Mamdani, in a story-driven and snake-inspired arcade game!

  • Explore seven unique areas of New York and get to know New Yorkers who live there: Inwood, Harlem, Central Park, Times Square, West Village, Chinatown, and Wall Street

  • Uncover documents inspired by real life events that tell the story of New York during the 2025 Mayoral Race

  • Bring a friend to play "Socialist Mode" where two players share controls and take turns guiding Zohran (local-coop only)

Core Gameplay:

  • Form the longest line of supporters you can while dodging misinformation

  • Drop off supporters at the bus stop before you run out of stamina

  • Supports keyboard controls with WASD and arrow keys

Disclaimers:

  • This is a work of fiction for entertainment purposes produced and developed by Antifun Bloc. 100% of proceeds go to Antifun Bloc and the development team behind the game

  • This game contains satirical and parodic content referencing public figures and recognizable imagery for commentary and entertainment purposes only.

  • All third-party materials, names, or likenesses are used transformatively and fall within fair use principles within U.S. law. 

  • No endorsement or affiliation with any third parties including Zohran Mamdani or his campaign is implied. 

  • All assets are original or properly licensed, and the developer will promptly remove or modify any element identified as infringing upon valid third-party rights.

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: macOS 11 Big Sur or newer
  • Processor: Intel (2015+) or Apple Silicon
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel Iris or Apple M1/M2+ (Metal)
  • Storage: 250 MB available space

name: Zohran's Run

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-6100 / AMD FX-4350 (or any 2C/4T 2015+)
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated (Intel HD 530 / UHD 620 / Iris 540+) or any DX11 card
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 250 MB available space
